dict.string: GnarTerm (Dev) and the coding agents running inside it read files in your Documents folder when you point them at projects or ask them to explore.
GnarTerm (Dev) and the coding agents running inside it read files in your Downloads folder when you open or reference them in a workspace.
GnarTerm (Dev) and the coding agents running inside it read files on your Desktop when you point them at projects or drop a folder onto a pane.
GnarTerm (Dev) needs this to walk into your ~/Music tree when an agent enumerates or searches under your home directory; it does not access Apple Music itself.
GnarTerm (Dev) needs this to walk into your ~/Pictures tree when an agent enumerates or searches under your home directory; it does not import photos.
GnarTerm (Dev) reads files on removable volumes when you open a workspace whose path lives on one.
GnarTerm (Dev) reads files on network volumes when you open a workspace whose path lives on one.
